nodes.label: Sage owns the price once the item exists; sheet prices only on create
nodes.rationale: Nozy's random price changes: each Sage company's copy of an item overwrote the one ERPNext item; prices differ per copy because a sheet cannot update an existing Sage item.

nodes.label: Own-company rule in the item sync (item.custom_category == integration.company)
nodes.rationale: Each Sage company overwrote item-level fields (price, selection id, tax type, item_group); last company to run won.

nodes.label: QOH sync sums the three Sage companies (custom_sage_qoh_by_company)
nodes.rationale: With all integrations pointing at Main Distribution, each run set the Bin to its own company's on-hand; the last company won per item.

nodes.label: POS switched to Sales Invoice mode (tax invoice per till sale)
nodes.rationale: Till sales never reached Sage, so the QOH sync wrote every sale back into Main Distribution (stock leak); a tax invoice per sale is mandatory for Ardmore.
